items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: All four ACs have L1 real-git tests through the gh stub: squash and rebase prove, retag, pass the guard and close 8 of 8; merge commit tags R and closes 8 of 8; a foreign commit with a drop stops with foreign_commits_on_base naming both, tags and record unchanged; re-runs identical and an origin tag never moves. Both review items of U2 (parent-tied proof, trunk 'not on origin' line) have tests.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Every refusal (merge_commit_unknown, merge_commit_changed, pr_head_not_the_release, merge_commit_not_on_base, foreign_commits_on_base, tag_on_origin_not_the_merge_commit, merge_state_unknown, retag_failed) happens before the record write except retag_failed, which a re-run repairs; an unreadable ls-remote stops without retagging.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: The proof now ties S to its parents so a hand-made S on a moved base is refused whichever base the record names; push-URL user:token is redacted from the JSON answer; git asks origin with prompts off; foreign commit subjects are cut to 80 characters with control characters removed.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Real git with a bare remote and the gh stub doing the squash/rebase/merge; negative cases for each refusal; the new proof tests were shown to fail on the old rule; stub contract tests for squash, rebase and pr view.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The new path runs only after gh reports MERGED with the release commit off the base; a merge-commit release adds no call, so no frozen trace moves; one extra fetch, all other calls local.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Writer in a new 151-line lib/release_publish.py, push-tag stays 108 lines; one proof rule shared by writer, guard and verify; gh_stub.py kept at 299 lines.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: release_state.json: producer push-tag (release_publish.publish via release_commit.write_state), consumers release_guard and release_verify through release_merge_proof; round-tripped in the e2e test (written by the CLI, read by the in-process guard and the close-phase CLI). gh pr view JSON: producer gh stub, consumer release_publish.merge_facts, round-tripped likewise.
